summary: Quantum BioPharma filed a Form 6-K furnishing a press release announcing a supplement to its management information circular dated September 28, 2026, ahead of its annual general and special meeting scheduled for November 10, 2026 at 1:00 p.m. ET. The supplement corrects and restates the special resolution authorizing a consolidation of class A multiple voting shares and class B subordinate voting shares, clarifying that fractional shares at or below one-half round down and above one-half round up. It also caps MVS holders' aggregate voting power at 70% despite cancellations. This is routine meeting material, not a special situation.
